---

## Objective

What question or problem is being investigated?

## Evidence

Record all evidence collected. Distinguish direct observations from derived conclusions.

## Findings

Summarise what the evidence reveals. Each finding must be traceable to specific evidence.

## Unknowns

List what remains unknown due to insufficient evidence. Use UNKNOWN when no conclusion can be drawn.

## Conclusions

State conclusions supported by the evidence. Avoid speculation.

## Recommended Actions

Propose specific next steps based on the conclusions.
